newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Want Want Holdings sets up China unit.
newsitem.headline: Want Want Holdings sets up China unit.

text.p: Want Want Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had incorporated a new subsidiary in Guangzhou, China known as Guangzhou Be-Want Foods Ltd.
The unit will manufacture snacks, frozen food, sauce, canned food, beverages like milk, wine for the wholesale and retail markets and for import and export, it said in a statement.
The new company will also provide related services in the sale of Want Want Group products.
Its investment in the China unit is US$9.7 million and its registered capital is US$4.85 million.
